description: Prompt-area lifecycle: immediate unfinished text, GA-confirmed prompts, commit-on-game-send, replacement by server lines, and no-GA login automation.

scenarios.name: GA prompt shows in the overlay and commits when a game line is accepted

steps.note: the submitted game line commits the prompt to scrollback

scenarios.name: a server line commits a confirmed prompt before its output

steps.note: GA made the prompt a separate record

scenarios.name: unterminated login prompts can trigger immediately

steps.note: Username prompt has no CR/LF, GA, or EOR
sending the username separated the two unfinished tails

scenarios.name: an automated prompt response closes stale multiline state

steps.note: the no-GA prompt is displayed and answered by Lua
the outbound line is an ordered local boundary even without UI submission
